closedFindings.resolution: Observed repeated candle series across an interior grid row or common-baseline flat red/green bar series forces AMBIGUOUS_PRICE_PANELS. It does not choose a subpanel or infer a divider. Both exact independent controls now exist in the author suite and passed.

Original raster cap is 4000000 pixels with no resizing. More than 256 accepted candle witnesses returns RASTER_TOO_COMPLEX before spread/pair comparisons. Common-baseline scan returns RASTER_TOO_COMPLEX above 1024 colored components or 128 qualifying flat bars before group comparisons. No prefix of evidence is accepted. A dense cluster too narrow for the wide-baseline early exit is now a focused passing HOLD control.

retainedRegression.reviewMethod: Read retained source-pinned author assay and script, verified hashes and exact result equality; did not repeat assay or read private image.

sourceAssessment: Consumes only original raster and existing grid/candle pixel helpers; no model ROI, source-case identity, oracle, numeric price inputs or provider dependency.
Observed integer or half-stroke pixel centres are converted to full-image percentages using actual dimensions. There is no inferred unit conversion or repaired bound.
Ambiguous, unsupported, malformed or over-budget evidence remains held. The added guards only withhold results; neither creates new boundary candidates.
Measured text-region evidence remains nonnumeric. Subsequent OCR, numeric scale corroboration and current-image identity binding remain prerequisites for any price placement.
limits: This accepts the specific reviewed bounded detector and closes demonstrated failures, not unique-panel proof for arbitrary images. Supported red/green candles, regular rectangular grids and adjacent glyph columns remain a deliberately narrow class.

Dense, borderless, clipped, unsupported-color, ambiguous or oversized inputs may hold. No generalization or physical-device performance claim follows from synthetic coverage or one retained development image.
The new four-million-pixel and component budgets reduce exposure; the detector remains synchronous. No worst-case mobile latency measurement has been made.
This receipt does not accept browser OCR, axis-policy changes, production route/UI wiring, semantic support/resistance correctness or the complete one-pixel benchmark.
